issue_context.title: Support `--test-name-pattern` in run()
issue_context.body:
### What is the problem this feature will solve?

Currently, `--test-name-pattern` can be provided when running tests from the command line, but not when running them via the [`run()` API](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html#runoptions).

### What is the feature you are proposing to solve the problem?

Have a new option like `namePatterns?: string[]` in the options.

### What alternatives have you considered?

_No response_
comments: I'd like to work on this, if that's ok

review_comments:
is this faster than 
```suggestion
    testNamePatterns = ArrayPrototypeConcat(testNamePatterns);
```
?

I honestly don't know 🤔 
Is `concat` quicker? I am happy to change this to concat, but I do I see 2 other times this is implemented: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/c7c46e2a523016f93d84a096f9bd51ba6bf6fc0a/lib/_http_outgoing.js#L698-L700 https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/c7c46e2a523016f93d84a096f9bd51ba6bf6fc0a/lib/internal/errors.js#L1211-L1213
Personally I find concat much more idiomatic, but I see a note that it's not a safe primordial to use, so what you have is the better approach :-) please mark this as resolved.
